name: analysis-web-capture
title: Web capture
description: Capture a web page's motion as reference tracks, frame by frame, in the person's own headless Chrome with an injected clock, from the load or from a click, hover, leave or scroll sent at a set time: each tracked element's box, transform and opacity and the window's scroll at source time, the same bytes on every run and at any machine speed, with the page's own keyframes kept as declared and the sha256 of every response
